# Agent Transport Gateway

Experimental transport-neutral request guard and integration boundary for AIX messages over existing protocols.

- Project: https://github.com/PCakes303/agent-intelligence-ecosystem
- AIX Core: https://github.com/PCakes303/aix-core
- AIX Codecs: https://github.com/PCakes303/aix-codecs
- Contract: docs/TRANSPORT-CONTRACT.md
- Threat model: docs/THREAT-MODEL.md
- Implementation: gateway_guard/guard.py
- Tests: tests/test_guard.py

This scaffold is not a network listener, authentication provider, production gateway, or MCP/A2A conformance implementation.
